mentions.name: Offline WiFi Community Forum
mentions.description: This Django-based forum is an "offline" social media platform designed to be accessed only from a single isolated WiFi network via captive portal techniques. It aims to be a geographically isolated, community-moderated digital bulletin board with a Reddit-style karma system in which enough down-votes delete a post. It is not yet production-ready and the author is seeking contributors, particularly for frontend (JavaScript/CSS) work.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A django-based "offline" social media platform (i.e. forum) designed for access only from a single (isolated) WiFi network via captive portal techniques. The goal is a "digital bulletin board" that is geographically isolated and community-moderated (think Reddit's karma system but enough down-votes will delete your post).

Not anywhere near production-ready yet but if this is up your street and you want to contribute then I'd be grateful!
